description: Naming a bookmark in the player, as viewer, a non-admin, on Chaptered Movie (2022), whose embedded chapters are Opening (0 s), Bank job (12 s), Chase (24 s), a ripper's 'Chapter 4' (36 s) and an untitled fifth chapter Jellyfin names 'Chapter 5' (48 s): with the defaults (AskForName off) Shift+B creates a bookmark at once without pausing, with the toast 'Bookmarked at 0:1x' and 'Name it'; Name it opens the name dialog with the chapter's title 'Bank job' suggested, focused and selected; keys pressed with the focus on its Save button never reach the player's shortcuts (M, K, 5 and ArrowLeft leave the video unmuted, playing and where it was); typing replaces the suggestion and Enter saves ('Named "…".', the server has the name); the dialog's 'Always ask for a name' saves the preference, and the next Shift+B opens the dialog at once ('Chase' in that chapter, nothing in 'Chapter 4', whose name is generic); Escape leaves the bookmark unnamed; with 'Pause while naming' the dialog pauses playback and Escape resumes it. Run by bookmarks-player-probe.mjs, which puts the preferences back and deletes the bookmarks; on its own it needs ShowPlayerButtons on and viewer's preferences at the defaults.

steps.name: sign in as viewer
the Bookmarks script ran
find Chaptered Movie
steps.eval: (await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: 'Chaptered Movie', Limit: 1 })).Items[0].Id

steps.name: its chapters, as ApiClient.getItem returns them (SB3)
titled chapters, a ripper's generic one and the untitled one Jellyfin named
viewer's bookmarks on it from an earlier run deleted
steps.script: let n = 0; for (const b of await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.movieId }))) { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'DELETE', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + b.Id) }); n++; } return n;

steps.name: the capabilities: the defaults, the buttons on, chapter names suggested
steps.eval: (c => ({ askForName: c.AskForName, isDefault: c.AskForNameIsDefault, pause: c.PauseWhileNaming, buttons: c.ShowPlayerButtons, suggest: c.SuggestChapterNames, shortcut: c.Shortcuts.BookmarkNow }))(await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Capabilities')))

steps.name: AskForName off (the server default), no pause, ShowPlayerButtons and SuggestChapterNames on, Shift+B
open the details page
details page with a Play button
start playback
video page, video playing
the three buttons (ShowPlayerButtons on), the tooltip naming Shift+B
inside 'Bank job' (12-24 s)
press Shift, then Shift+B
one bookmark at once, unnamed, and the toast with Name it; playback not paused
steps.waitFor: (async () => { const list = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.movieId })); const v = document.querySelector('.videoPlayerContainer video'); const toast = [...document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-toast')].find(t => /^Bookmarked at \d+:\d\d\.Name it$/.test(t.textContent)); if (list.length !== 1 || !toast) return false; return { id: list[0].Id, startSeconds: list[0].StartTicks / 10000000, name: list[0].Name || null, paused: v.paused, toast: toast.textContent, dialog: !!document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop') }; })()

steps.name: created at once in 'Bank job', without a name, without pausing, without a dialog (AskForName off)
the first bookmark's id
Name it
the name dialog: 'Bank job' suggested, focused and fully selected; 'Always ask for a name' unticked; More…, Skip, Save
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); if (!p || p.querySelector('h3').textContent !== 'Name this bookmark') return false; const input = p.querySelector('input[type=text]'); return { value: input.value, focused: document.activeElement === input, selection: [input.selectionStart, input.selectionEnd], maxlength: input.getAttribute('maxlength'), alwaysAsk: p.querySelector('.jfbm-always-ask input').checked, where: p.querySelector('.jfbm-name-where').textContent, buttons: [...p.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-actions button')].map(b => b.textContent), toasts: document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-toast').length }; })()

steps.name: as expected: the chapter's title, selected, so typing replaces it
steps.assert: __vars.dialog.value === 'Bank job' && __vars.dialog.focused === true && __vars.dialog.selection[0] === 0 && __vars.dialog.selection[1] === 8 && __vars.dialog.maxlength === '100' && __vars.dialog.alwaysAsk === false && /^Bookmarked at \d+:\d\d in Chaptered Movie \(2022\)\.$/.test(__vars.dialog.where) && JSON.stringify(__vars.dialog.buttons) === JSON.stringify(['More…', 'Skip', 'Save']) && __vars.dialog.toasts === 0

steps.name: focus the Save button, note the video's state
steps.script: [...document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-actions button')].find(b => b.textContent === 'Save').focus(); const v = document.querySelector('.videoPlayerContainer video'); return { focusedSave: document.activeElement.textContent === 'Save', currentTime: v.currentTime, muted: v.muted, paused: v.paused };

steps.name: the focus is on Save
M (mute), K (pause), 5 (seek to 50 %) and ArrowLeft (seek back) with the focus on Save (Space and Enter are the button's own click, which stays)
the video's state afterwards
steps.eval: (v => ({ currentTime: v.currentTime, muted: v.muted, paused: v.paused, dialog: !!document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'), focusedSave: document.activeElement && document.activeElement.textContent === 'Save' }))(document.querySelector('.videoPlayerContainer video'))

steps.name: none of them reached the player: not muted, not paused, no jump to 30 s and no seek back; the dialog still open
back in the field, the suggestion selected
steps.script: const input = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop input[type=text]'); input.focus(); input.select(); return document.activeElement === input;

steps.name: type a name: it replaces the suggestion
the field holds the typed name
Enter saves
named: the dialog gone, the toast, the server's name with the time unchanged
steps.waitFor: (async () => { if (document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop')) return false; const toast = [...document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-toast')].find(t => t.textContent === 'Named "player-probe Vault".'); if (!toast) return false; const b = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + __vars.firstId)); return { name: b.Name, startSeconds: b.StartTicks / 10000000, playing: !document.querySelector('.videoPlayerContainer video').paused }; })()

steps.name: the server has the name and the same position; playback went on
inside 'Chase' (24-36 s)
Shift, then Shift+B
the second bookmark and its toast
steps.waitFor: (async () => { const list = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.movieId })); const toast = [...document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-toast')].find(t => /^Bookmarked at \d+:\d\d\.Name it$/.test(t.textContent)); if (list.length !== 2 || !toast) return false; const b = list.find(x => x.Id !== __vars.firstId); return { id: b.Id, startSeconds: b.StartTicks / 10000000 }; })()

steps.name: Name it
the dialog with 'Chase'
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); return !!p && p.querySelector('h3').textContent === 'Name this bookmark' && p.querySelector('input[type=text]').value === 'Chase'; })()

steps.name: in 'Chase'
tick 'Always ask for a name'
the preference saved on the server (POST /Bookmarks/Preferences)
steps.waitFor: (async () => { const p = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Preferences')); return p.AskForName === true && p.PauseWhileNaming === false ? p : false; })()

steps.name: the capabilities follow
Skip
skipped: the dialog gone, the second bookmark unnamed
inside 'Chapter 4' (36-48 s), whose name is generic
Shift, then Shift+B
Always ask: the dialog at once, no toast, with an empty field ('Chapter 4' is never suggested, SB3)
steps.waitFor: (async () => { const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); if (!p || p.querySelector('h3').textContent !== 'Name this bookmark') return false; const list = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.movieId })); if (list.length !== 3) return false; const b = list.find(x => x.Id !== __vars.firstId && x.Id !== __vars.second.id); const input = p.querySelector('input[type=text]'); return { id: b.Id, startSeconds: b.StartTicks / 10000000, value: input.value, focused: document.activeElement === input, alwaysAsk: p.querySelector('.jfbm-always-ask input').checked, toasts: document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-toast').length, paused: document.querySelector('.videoPlayerContainer video').paused }; })()

steps.name: in 'Chapter 4', the field empty and focused, the box ticked, no toast, still playing (no pause preference yet)
Escape leaves it unnamed
the dialog gone, the player still open and playing, the third bookmark unnamed
'Pause while naming' on, through the preferences endpoint (not the My Bookmarks page's Player options dialog)
steps.script: await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Preferences'), data: JSON.stringify({ AskForName: true, PauseWhileNaming: true }), contentType: 'application/json' }); return await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Preferences'));

details page with a Play button
reload, so the page reads the capabilities again
the Bookmarks script ran again

steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); const v = document.querySelector('.videoPlayerContainer video'); if (!p || p.querySelector('h3').textContent !== 'Name this bookmark' || !v.paused) return false; return { value: p.querySelector('input[type=text]').value, paused: v.paused, currentTime: v.currentTime }; })()

steps.script: const b = document.querySelector('.videoOsdBottom .btnBookmarkAdd'); b.click(); b.click(); return true;

steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); const v = document.querySelector('.videoPlayerContainer video'); if (!p || p.querySelector('h3').textContent !== 'Name this bookmark' || !v.paused) return false; return { dialogs: document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-backdrop').length, value: p.querySelector('input[type=text]').value, toasts: document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-toast').length }; })()

steps.script: const list = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.movieId })); return { dialogs: document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-backdrop').length, bookmarks: list.length };

steps.eval: (await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.movieId }))).map(b => ({ startSeconds: b.StartTicks / 10000000, name: b.Name || null }))
